rear.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: rear-view game sprite for an editable 2D skeletal cutout. Input image 1 is the accepted Dust Acolyte FRONT reference (identity, exact proportions, silhouette, palette, painted pixel texture and clothing), not a replacement target. Draw ONLY the matching rear three-quarter view of this same skeletal hooded caster, as if turned 180 degrees on a 2:1 isometric tactical board. Preserve the tall dark umber/brown hood, long weathered brown robe, tan narrow trim and angular pixel-readable paint; no redesign. The open casting skeletal hand and small orange ember/orb stay on the same anatomical side: in this rear view they appear on the viewer RIGHT, arm extended slightly with open palm up and the orb floating above it. The other hand hangs/rests modestly on viewer LEFT and is largely concealed by its sleeve. Show the back of the hood, shoulders and full rear robe all the way to the ragged grounded hem, with no invented staff, sword, armor, shoes, face visible through the back, wings or decorative effects. Match the original body/hood/arm scale and floor projection; a full body composition with generous transparent margin, no cast shadow, no border, no text. Keep the orb separate in silhouette above the hand. Genuinely transparent RGBA background; no checkerboard or solid backdrop. One character only.
rear.disposition: Selected for design; original RGB checkerboard excludes use without the recorded background selection.
